answer: The haven register is checked at draw time, meadow lists the eligible set, and yarrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 82 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 82 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 33 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
